				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>Individually designed rooms await you at the Tenerife Surf Camp, from cosy single or double rooms to spacious suites and stylish dormitories &#8211; all with comfort and charm.</p><p>Our communal areas strike the perfect balance between socializing and relaxation. Unwind in the lounge with surf videos and weekly coaching, play pool with new friends, or enjoy a cold beer in the garden. The garden also features hammocks, a communal kitchen with a dining area for barbecues. And the sun terrace with sea views is the perfect place to prepare for surfing with yoga.</p><p>High-speed internet is available throughout the surf camp for anyone who needs to work on the computer in between. And in our Surfer&#8217;s Corner you will find everything a surfer&#8217;s heart desires, including secure storage for your equipment.</p>								</div>

				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>The heart of the Tenerife Surf Camp and daily meeting point is the lovingly designed outdoor bar in the garden. A delicious, healthy breakfast awaits you here every morning to give you the boost you need to start your surfing day full of energy.</p>
<p>But the outdoor bar is the place for more than just breakfast. In the afternoon, you can order fresh juices, smoothies and healthy snacks here. And in the evenings, it&#8217;s where all the surf camp mates get together for the weekly camp dinners or the legendary BBQs with local produce, fresh fish and seafood and Canarian wine.</p>
<p>You also have the opportunity to cook for yourself. There is a fully equipped kitchen at your disposal with plenty of space for storing food, snacks and drinks.</p><p><span style="color: var( --e-global-color-2549527 ); font-family: var( --e-global-typography-text-font-family ), Sans-serif; background-color: var( --e-global-color-text ); text-align: var(--text-align);">You should also not miss out on a visit to a typical local restaurant to discover the local flavours of Canarian and Spanish cuisine.</span></p>								</div>
